subject: general
question:
Which two signs and numbers need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

24 - (9 ÷ 12) + (84 × 4) + 28 = 23
solution: Here, we use the BODMAS table given below: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] Given: ⇒ 24 - (9 ÷ 12) + (84 × 4) + 28 = 23 (1) **24 and 28, - and ÷** ⇒ 24 - (9 ÷ 12) + (84 × 4) + 28 = 23 After interchanging the sign and numbers: ⇒ 28 ÷ __**(9 - 12)**__ + __**(84 × 4) **__+ 24 = 23 Apply BODMAS rule: ⇒ __**28 ÷ (-3)**__ + 336 + 24 ⇒ (-9.33) + 336 + 24
